calibration_note: ASSUMED calibration for clip_03 (no measured ground-truth distances available). Sanctioned assumption: standard Indian lane width = 3.5 m (IRC); the 9 m dash cycle (3 m stripe + 6 m gap) is the along-road reference wherever dashes are visible (not confirmed in this clip). Ground scale was anchored to this: YOLO car bbox width fit (1.8 m over 58 front/rear detections, conf>=0.5, bbox w/h<=2.0, px/m = 0.3346*(y - 66.9), r2=0.975) served as an internal estimate and was cross-checked against lane-line gaps on clip_06: median 3.24-3.36 m per lane, within ~5% of the 3.5 m standard. One-point-perspective camera model: height 2.99 m, horizon y=66.9, focal 500 px, cx=320 (~65 deg HFOV on 640-wide frame). To swap in a real field measurement later: edit homography_src/dst_points and this note - no code changes needed. Redo before production use.
